about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for bc-changes-2023 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The underlined title is split into two headings at a line break, so the body text sits under a fragment heading.
findings.evidence: source: "...procedural building regulations applying to buildings in England." / tree: "...procedural building" + "regulations applying to buildings in England."

findings.problem: The letterhead's two columns (recipients and sender address) are mixed into one text.
findings.evidence: tree: "To: (England only) Fry Building 2 Marsham Street Local Government Chief Executives and London SW1P 4DF Heads of Building Control"

findings.problem: The bold question headings 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 are read as body text and merged into one text block with their answers.
findings.evidence: tree: "1.1. I deposited full plans to the local authority for a higher-risk building, but the plans were rejected prior to 1 October 2023"

findings.problem: The bold numbered list of topics is read as three separate headings instead of a list under the intro line.
findings.evidence: tree: "1) transitional provisions 2) statutory consultations" / "3) work in existing higher-risk buildings 4) enforcement" / "5) lapse of plans"

findings.problem: The bold question headings 3.3, 3.4, 4.1 and 4.2 are run into the body text instead of being kept as headings, so separate questions are merged into one section.
findings.evidence: source: "3.3. Will the Regulator notify a local authority..." (bold heading) / tree: "...other than the Regulator. 3.3. Will the Regulator notify..."

findings.problem: The headings 'Changes to enforcement for all buildings' and 'Compliance and stop notices' are kept as body text inside one long text block.
findings.evidence: tree: "not to private sector building control. Changes to enforcement for all buildings Compliance and stop notices The Building Safety Act 2022"

findings.problem: The underlined heading and the italic subheading are run into the body text instead of being kept as headings.
findings.evidence: tree: "not to private sector building control. Changes to enforcement for all buildings Compliance and stop notices The Building Safety Act 2022"

findings.problem: The heading for regulation 14A is kept as body text, and regulations 14 and 14A are merged into one text block.
findings.evidence: tree: "dwelling-house or flat. Determination of applications for building control approval with full plans 14A.—(1) Subject to paragraph (5)"

findings.problem: The quoted amending regulations are placed under the heading 'Enquiries', which is not their parent.
The heading for regulation 14A is kept as body text, and regulations 14 and 14A are merged into one text block.
findings.evidence: tree: "dwelling-house or flat. Determination of applications for building control approval with full plans 14A.—(1)"
